snippet.title: OFFICIAL TEASER "No Jokes With Mages"
snippet.description:
No Jokes With Mages — Official Teaser

PLAY DEMO ON ITCH.IO
https://exrealite.itch.io/nojokeswithmages
WISHLIST ON STEAM
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3465130/No_Jokes_With_Mages/
WE ON TWITTER 
https://x.com/EXREALITE

Step into the surreal world of Limb in No Jokes With Mages. Join Dwight, an ordinary teenager, on a haunting journey through the depths of his own subconscious. In this atmospheric adventure, your deepest fears take the form of mysterious mages, and the only way out is to face them head-on.

Will you help Dwight uncover the truth hidden within his shadows?

Key Features:

Explore the Limb: A visually stunning, surreal world where every environment reflects a fragment of the human psyche.

Emotional Narrative: A deep, story-driven experience about growing up and overcoming internal struggles.

Unique Art Style: An atmospheric aesthetic that perfectly captures the eerie yet beautiful nature of the subconscious.

Introspective Puzzles: Solve challenges that are tied to Dwight’s emotions and memories.

#NoJokesWithMages #IndieGame #AdventureGame #Atmospheric #Psychological #Gaming #SteamTrailer #indiedev
